title: Two fields share one field number
fix: Give the new field the next unused number and never move an existing one.

title: A reserved field number was taken back
fix: Leave reserved numbers reserved forever and allocate a fresh number.

title: A reserved field name was taken back
fix: Pick a new name; reserved names are still in old JSON payloads and generated accessors.

title: Field number inside the protobuf-internal range
fix: Use a number outside 19000-19999; protoc refuses that range.

title: Field number outside the legal range
A hole in the field numbers is not reserved
fix: Add a reserved statement for the deleted numbers so nobody recycles the tag.

title: Two fields share one name
fix: Rename one of them; protoc rejects duplicate field names in a message.

title: Two fields map to the same JSON name
fix: Rename one field or pin an explicit json_name so JSON and proto agree.

title: The first proto3 enum value is not zero
fix: Add a ..._UNSPECIFIED = 0 value as the first entry.

title: Two enum values share one number without allow_alias
fix: Give the new value its own number, or set option allow_alias = true on purpose.

title: A hole in the enum numbers is not reserved
fix: Reserve the removed enum numbers so they are never reissued with a new meaning.

title: No syntax declaration
fix: Put syntax = "proto3"; on the first line; without it protoc silently compiles the file as proto2.

title: No package declaration
fix: Declare a versioned package so two linked files cannot collide in the global namespace.

title: A required field
fix: Use a plain or optional field; a required field can never be removed without breaking every old reader.

title: A proto2 default on a proto3 field
fix: Delete the default option; proto3 has no custom defaults, so apply it in code.

title: Unset and zero cannot be told apart
fix: Mark the field optional so the reader can see the difference between absent and zero.

title: Packing turned off on a repeated scalar
fix: Drop packed = false; it changes the bytes on the wire against the proto3 default.
